What this changes and why, in a few plain sentences.

How you tested it: the `pytest` run, plus anything you ran by hand (a review or a ticket check on your machine).

- [ ] `python3 -m pytest tests` passes
- [ ] A change to anything that gets installed bumps `version` in `kit.json` and adds the same line to `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] `python3 package.py --check` says up to date
- [ ] No personal data: no names, emails, home paths, project maps, your profile or `kit.config.json`
- [ ] A change to the guards, `post_review.py` or what gets pushed comes with a test for the new case
